MindFuture’s application to The Cultural Council, Høje Taastrup Municipality

On the occasion of Vestegnen's Culture Week 2022, MindFuture at Erik Husfeldts Vej 7 will host two art events about democracy and artificial intelligence, which relate to the municipality's theme of open cultural communities. We hereby seek support to honor two artists, while MindFuture covers all other expenses related to holding the events.

The format is a "voter meeting" for the project The Synthetic Party, driven by artist and philosopher [the operator]. Over two afternoons on the weekend 10/11 September, the party will invite ordinary people into a culture where the machines set the agenda. For this, we expect to engage 200-400 people over the two days. Through collaboration with Høje Taastrup Libraries, the artists will tailor the format so it can be part of the Culture Package, allowing us to invite school classes in the senior grades.

About Det Syntetiske Parti

Det Syntetiske Parti was launched in June 2022, and has received quite a bit of media attention. The party is led by an artificial intelligence that has read all the crazy and wild ideas that completely ordinary people have written on the internet in connection with their private establishments of small parties. In this way, the party can demonstrate what forms of political representation become possible with artificial intelligence, and show how the population's visions are conveyed through a machine.

Details about the events 

The two events will take the form of workshops, where [the operator] [████] will guide people in communicating with a political chatbot, creating logos and icons with artificial intelligence, and producing digital poetry with both words and images through the technology. The participants will, perhaps for the first time, try talking to an AI, participate in 'policy development,' and receive tools to program themselves using easy and publicly available machine learning tools.

The two artists will establish a situation where the participants are members of Det Syntetiske Parti and thus will feel that they have the opportunity to influence the technology – rather than it influencing them. The purpose is therefore to strengthen democratic education, so that new phenomena like 'spam bots' and 'troll armies' do not appear as alien creatures from another world, but as something that one can understand and take responsibility for.
